capabilities: Encrypt selected text or an entire note inline
Decrypt encrypted blocks via command palette or context menu
Insert pre-encrypted text into a note
Copy decrypted secrets to the clipboard without showing them (Ctrl)
Decrypt secrets outside Obsidian with a standalone HTML tool
extras: Warns that lost passwords mean permanently lost data; passwords and decrypted content are kept only in memory, with decryption to disk happening only for the 'Decrypt selected text' command. Includes an external single-file HTML decryptor in tools/decrypt.html.
intentEvidence: It was inspired by Obsidian Encrypt Plugin.
problem: Obsidian notes are plain local files, so secrets stored in them are readable by anyone with access to the vault.

relations.evidence: It was inspired by Obsidian Encrypt Plugin.

summary: Inline encryption plugin that encrypts selected text or whole notes in place as code blocks, decrypted on demand with a password.
